name: Nine Whys
deliverable: Progressive conversational excavation of intrinsic organizational purpose

steps.text: Pair people and have one describe an activity or project they care about in a sentence or two.
Instruct the partner to ask "Why is that important to you?" and nothing else for the first rounds.
Keep asking why of each answer, following the chain rather than accepting the first reason.
Notice when the answer stops being about the task and starts naming a person or value worth serving.
Switch roles and run the same chain, then have each person state the purpose they reached in one line.

failure: The partner accepts a general answer like "because it matters" and the chain stalls at a slogan instead of reaching a real purpose.
intervention: Ask the follow-up once more: "Why does that matter to you, specifically?" Keep the silence until the answer gets concrete.
provenance: Steps written for this deck from the method's public definition; the source has no protocol.

origin.title: The Surprising Power of Liberating Structures
